action_records.rationale: Identify the named thesis and report, establish whether they share data or constitute independent studies, and determine whether either reports a relevant functional recovery endpoint. This tests the provisional localized reactive-lime-reservoir explanation; it predicts recovery associated with exposed lime-rich regions and is challenged by matched lime-free specimens recovering identically. Support is limited to modern lime-pozzolan mortar with identified lime-rich inclusions; transfer to Utah asphalt records is unresolved. Record provenance and report negative searches without treating absence of retrieval as evidence.
